prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble, in real places. Seen through a cut-crystal whiskey tumbler in the foreground, the middle of the frame breaks into a dozen faceted fragments, each a slightly shifted copy of the room edged with thin rainbow fringes; outside the glass the frame is a plain realistic photograph. A smoky back room: at a long table of whole hams and champagne, gangsters in pinstripes and a tall skinny man in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache freeze mid-bite, forks in the air, all turned to the open door, where a heavy-set Black baker in a floury vest stands holding one small loaf. Light: one low brass lamp with a green glass shade over the table; the doorway cold blue. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
